placement: Tooling — src/tooling/hot-reload.ts (dev-only browser side, tooling layer) and scripts/dev-server.ts (npm run dev: static files and a change stream). The replacement policy is a pure function: CSS swaps in place, HTML remounts, an engine is restored only from a snapshot whose version equals the new engine's exactly (never guessed), otherwise it resets, and anything else reloads the page. The browser side holds no copy of application state: the engine produces and consumes its own versioned snapshot. Nothing ships in the kernel or the default package path.
